body:
Resolves #716.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `checkWorktrees` in `packages/preflight/lib/checks.mjs` passes `-c core.hooksPath=/dev/null` when invoking `git worktree add --detach` so target repository `post-checkout` hooks never execute with the operator ambient environment.
2. `packages/preflight/README.md` documents that `--worktrees` disables repository hooks via `-c core.hooksPath=/dev/null`.
3. Unit tests in `packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs` verify that an executable `.git/hooks/post-checkout` hook in the target repo does not fire during `checkWorktrees`.
title: preflight: disable repository hooks during --worktrees checkout probe (#716)
